divorceTerminology.jurisdictionBasis: Domicile OR ordinary residence for 1+ year in South Africa (s.2(1), Domicile Act 3 of 1992)

legalCitations.description: Governs divorce proceedings — grounds, maintenance, parental responsibilities and rights, and property redistribution
Governs matrimonial property regimes — in community of property, out of community with/without accrual
Governs parental responsibilities and rights — guardianship, care, and contact
Governs maintenance (spousal and child support) obligations and enforcement

legalCitations.code: Recognition of Customary Marriages Act 120 of 1998
legalCitations.description: Recognises customary marriages — both monogamous and polygynous; default in community of property

legalCitations.code: Justices of the Peace and Commissioners of Oaths Act 16 of 1963
legalCitations.description: Governs the taking of oaths and affirmations — affidavits sworn before a Commissioner of Oaths
Provides for protection orders against domestic violence

legalCitations.code: Mediation in Certain Divorce Matters Act 24 of 1987
legalCitations.description: Requires the Family Advocate to be involved when there are minor or dependent children in divorce proceedings
Governs pension sharing on divorce — Divorce Act s.7(7) and (8) allow the court to order a pension fund to pay a portion to the non-member spouse
Effective 14 May 2024 — amends the Divorce Act to recognise Muslim marriages and extend all divorce provisions to such marriages
